David Michineau was born on June 6, 1994.
David Michineau is a French basketball player.
David Michineau plays for Bursaspor Basketbol in the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL).
David Michineau was drafted by the New Orleans Pelicans in the 2016 NBA draft.
David Michineau's rights were traded to the Los Angeles Clippers on draft night.
David Michineau made his professional debut for ES Chalon-Sur-Saône during the 2013-14 season.
David Michineau helped Chalon advance to the final of the Leaders Cup in the 2015-16 season.
David Michineau helped Chalon reach the Final Four of the FIBA Europe Cup in the 2015-16 season.
David Michineau played in 34 Pro A contests during the 2015-16 season.
During the 2015-16 season, David Michineau averaged 5.6 points per game.
During the 2015-16 season, David Michineau averaged one rebound per game.
During the 2015-16 season, David Michineau averaged 1.5 assists per game.
On July 22, 2016, David Michineau signed with Hyères-Toulon.
On May 4, 2020, David Michineau re-signed with Levallois Metropolitans.
In the off-season of 2022, David Michineau left for Italy.
David Michineau agreed terms with Napoli Basket in the Lega Basket Serie A during the off-season of 2022.
On August 4, 2023, David Michineau signed with Bursaspor in the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL).
On June 23, 2016, David Michineau was selected by the New Orleans Pelicans in the 2016 NBA draft.
David Michineau joined the Los Angeles Clippers for the 2016 NBA Summer League.
On February 10, 2022, David Michineau's draft rights were traded to the Sacramento Kings as part of a four-team trade.
On February 8, 2023, the Sacramento Kings traded David Michineau's draft rights to the Brooklyn Nets in exchange for Kessler Edwards and cash considerations.
In 2012, David Michineau played in the Albert-Schweitzer-Tournament with the French under 18 national team.
